examples.title: Recipe with ingredients and steps
examples.description: An unordered list for ingredients and an ordered list for the method, inside a semantic article.
examples.code:
Pancakes

Ingredients

  • 200 g flour
  • 2 eggs
  • 300 ml milk

Method

  1. Whisk the eggs and milk.
  2. Stir in the flour until smooth.
  3. Fry ladlefuls in a hot pan for two minutes per side.

examples.title: Video with poster and captions
examples.description: A video element with two sources, a poster image and an English captions track.
examples.code:
<video controls width="640" height="360" poster="poster.jpg" preload="metadata">
  <source src="intro.webm" type="video/webm">
  <source src="intro.mp4" type="video/mp4">
  <track kind="captions" src="intro-en.vtt" srclang="en" label="English" default>
  Your browser does not support the video element.
</video>

examples.title: Search-friendly head
examples.description: A head section with title, description, canonical URL, Open Graph tags and JSON-LD structured data.
examples.code:
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Growing Tomatoes on a Balcony – Garden Notes</title>
  <meta name="description" content="A beginner's guide to growing cherry tomatoes in containers on a balcony.">
  <link rel="canonical" href="https://gardennotes.example/posts/balcony-tomatoes">
  <meta property="og:type" content="article">
  <meta property="og:title" content="Growing Tomatoes on a Balcony">
  <meta property="og:image" content="https://gardennotes.example/images/tomatoes.jpg">
  <script type="application/ld+json">
  {
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "@type": "Article",
    "headline": "Growing Tomatoes on a Balcony",
    "datePublished": "2026-05-02"
  }
  </script>
</head>
